body: Ready-to-use optical character recognition for more than 80 languages and multiple writing systems.
plain_description: **Extract text from images in more than 80 languages.** Use it to turn image text into readable text with confidence scores. Run it from Python or the command line, and choose CPU-only mode if needed.
technical_description: EasyOCR is a ready-to-use OCR library supporting more than 80 languages and common writing scripts. It detects text in images and returns bounding boxes, recognized text, and confidence scores. It supports Python and command-line use, can run in CPU-only mode, and can download model weights automatically or use manually downloaded weights.
title: EasyOCR
